releases.body:
## Summary
- add `OPENQWENCODE_BASE_URL` support for routing model requests through a custom OpenAI-compatible base URL
- add optional telemetry delivery, linked-device bearer auth, and the new `openqwencode link` device-link flow
- update smoke tests, package exports, README, and release checks for the new telemetry and linking behavior

## Changes

- rate-limit-reason-aware backoff classifies 429s by `x-error-code` into burst, quota, and transient categories with distinct retry windows
- quota-exhausted 429s now return `quota_exceeded` in OpenAI-compatible error JSON
- smoke tests now cover rate-limit reason classification for burst, quota, and transient cases
- a deterministic device-flow smoke test covers `authorization_pending`, `slow_down`, successful token issuance, and credential persistence

## Summary
- normalize upstream 429/5xx responses into OpenAI-compatible JSON so OpenCode shows clean rate-limit errors
- keep retry-after headers while silencing debug logs by default to avoid noisy OpenCode notifications
- publish version 0.1.6 with smoke-test coverage for the new rate-limit behavior

## Summary
- Normalize OpenCode chat payloads to the request shape Qwen accepts so local plugin runs stop failing on request formatting mismatches.
- Update upstream compatibility metadata and user-agent handling, and keep the smoke tests aligned with the new request normalization behavior.

## Summary
- Fix Qwen OAuth request compatibility by adding request metadata, sending the standard user-agent header, and preserving readable 401 responses when refresh fails.
- Add smoke-test coverage for readable refresh failures and make the user-agent version come from package metadata.
- Consolidate project rules, release workflow, and backlog into `AGENTS.md`, with a README note for clearing stale OpenCode plugin caches after upgrades.
